criteria.description: The survival run starts normally in a controllable, navigable voxel world.
The deterministic island visibly has navigable height variation, distinct resources, trees, landmarks, boundaries, and a safe spawn rather than a decorative flat grid.
Raycast selection, timed breaking, collection, hotbar choice, and neighboring-face placement visibly modify both geometry and collision while preventing placement inside the player.
Gathered wood and stone feed a real three-plus-three beacon recipe, and the beacon cannot be placed before it is visibly crafted.

The player can visibly construct a small enclosed shelter with a supported roof beacon, and its walls provide real protection; self-reported shelterValid or shelterCellCount fields alone are insufficient.

Sky and lighting progress through dusk, night, and dawn; exactly two hostiles visibly pursue and damage an exposed player but cannot attack through shelter walls; victory also requires the placed beacon and valid shelter.
Health, death or fall loss, gather-to-dawn victory, pause, and restart preserve coherent terrain and inventory state without debug shortcuts.
At 390 x 844 move/look, jump, break, place, attack, slot, and craft controls support the objective without hover, right-click, keyboard, or incoherent overlap.
